basics.name: Martin Birkenbaum
basics.label: Senior Software Engineer
basics.summary: Senior Software Engineer with 8+ years of experience designing, building, and deploying scalable backend services and cloud applications, with expertise in microservices architecture, GitOps-driven automation, and AI-enabled solutions. Passionate about well-tested, maintainable code, developer toolchains, and solving complex problems in high-volume data environments.

work.name: Initech Corporation
work.summary: Led architecture and development of high-throughput microservices and GitOps-driven infrastructure pipelines.
highlights: Designed and implemented Python-based event-driven microservices processing 10M+ daily events, delivering highly scalable solutions for complex, high-volume data processing environments.
Standardized containerized deployments utilizing Docker, Kubernetes, and GitOps workflows, enhancing cloud infrastructure reliability and CI/CD efficiency.
Mentored 6 junior/mid-level engineers, establishing local code styling and robust testing standards to ensure high code quality and maintainability.
Developed custom internal toolchains that reduced CI pipeline execution times by 40%, optimizing developer productivity and accelerating deployment cycles.

work.name: Hooli Inc.
work.summary: Backend engineer focused on building RESTful APIs, developer tooling, and automated deployment integrations.
highlights: Developed robust REST APIs in Python/Django and TypeScript/Node.js, supporting scalable web applications and external developer platforms.
Integrated third-party APIs and automated webhook processors, streamlining complex data flows and enabling seamless external platform integrations.
Implemented a comprehensive suite of unit and integration tests, raising code coverage from 60% to 92% and upholding high standards for code quality and reliability.
